name: application-event-calendar
title: Event Calendar
description: A week-view time grid with slotted event blocks, side-by-side overlap handling, and a live current-time indicator.
useWhen: Displaying a day or multi-day schedule where events occupy specific time slots rather than whole calendar cells.
Two or more events overlap in time and need to render side-by-side instead of stacking or hiding one another.
The user needs to see where 'now' falls relative to their scheduled events.
avoidWhen: You need a month-at-a-glance date picker for choosing a single date — use the existing `calendar` component instead.
Events don't carry specific start/end times — a plain list or the `timelines` component communicates sequence without a time axis.
responsiveBehavior: Day columns are flex-1 and share the remaining width evenly after a fixed-width time gutter; collapse to a single scrollable day column below the sm breakpoint in your own layout.
accessibility: Each event block carries a visible title and time range as text, not solely through position or color.
The current-time indicator is decorative (pointer-events-none) and should not be the only way users learn the current time.
Overlapping events keep a minimum readable width; avoid stacking more than two or three side-by-side before switching to a list view.

variants.title: Week grid
variants.description: Three-day time grid with hour rows, two side-by-side overlapping events, and a red current-time line.
accessibility: Event color is paired with a text title and time range so the schedule reads without relying on color alone.

variants.title: Week grid (Dark)
variants.description: Week grid adapted for dark scheduling surfaces, with muted event fills that keep text at WCAG AA contrast.
accessibility: Event fills and borders meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark grid background.
